title: oil stocks us strategic petroleum reserve fall by 31 million barrels lowest 2026 08 31
text:
Aug 31 (Reuters) - Stocks of crude oil ​in the ‌U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell ​by ​about 3.1 million barrels ⁠to 286.6 ​million barrels ​last week, the lowest level since ​November 1982, ​according to data from ‌the ⁠Department of Energy.
The drawdowns are part ​of ​a ⁠U.S. agreement to ​release 172 ​million ⁠barrels from the facility.
